---
applyTo: "certification/**,scripts/certify_ecosystem.py,tests/test_mfact_certification.py,.github/workflows/mfact-certification.yml"
---

Certification has VERIFY authority only.

- Never give the certification court CONSTRUCT or DO authority.
- A verifier must fail closed on contradictory evidence and remain read-only on the repository subject.
- Generated artifacts may be load-bearing evidence but cannot acquire semantic standing authority merely from their path or existence.
- Test stale receipt promotion, producer identity drift, mutable/placeholder identities, and generated-projection authority as adversarial cases.
- `ALIVE` requires exact-subject evidence satisfying the declared release/certification contract; otherwise return the strongest narrower standing supported by evidence.
